name: Kvant Scientific Research Institute
aliases: RUSSIAN FEDERAL STATE UNITARY ENTERPRISE SCIENTIFIC RESEARCH INSTITUTE KVANT
supervisors: Federal Security Service of the Russian Federation (FSB)

evidence.summary: The US Treasury designated the Kvant Scientific Research Institute in June 2018 as owned or controlled by Russia’s Federal Security Service (FSB), noting a 2010 government decree that made it a federal state unitary enterprise supervised by the FSB. OFAC lists it as linked to the FSB.
It belongs to Russia’s Federal Security Service (FSB), which supervises it.

sources.title: Treasury Sanctions Russian Federal Security Service Enablers (11 June 2018)
